fullText.simplified:
第十五章、后记

    在中国文化中，人们很早就相信“天人合一”，要通过修炼自身来理解自然。其中“道”、“心”、“空”都是很重要的内容。
    中国人认为，修炼的方法有很多种。有些人心思纯净，这样的人更容易修炼。他们往往学习能力特别好。比如孙悟空出生几天就会跑和跳，很快学会说话，跟葡提老师学习也特别快。对这样的人来说，学东西不是难事，难的是真正理解“空”的意思，所以葡提老师给他取名“悟空”。
    要真正理解“空”，不能只在家里读书，一定要离开家，认识更大的世界。这就是为什么葡提老师预见到孙悟空命里会有大事发生，虽然知道他会遇到很多危险，但还是让他离开。后来，孙悟空会遇到第二个重要的师父唐三藏，那时他会得到新名字“孙行者”——意思是“修行的人”或“旅行的人”。从那以后，孙悟空就要开始他“西游”的旅行了。
fullText.traditional:
第十五章、後記

    在中國文化中，人們很早就相信“天人合一”，要通過修煉自身來理解自然。其中“道”、“心”、“空”都是很重要的內容。
    中國人認為，修煉的方法有很多種。有些人心思純淨，這樣的人更容易修煉。他們往往學習能力特別好。比如孫悟空出生幾天就會跑和跳，很快學會說話，跟葡提老師學習也特別快。對這樣的人來說，學東西不是難事，難的是真正理解“空”的意思，所以葡提老師給他取名“悟空”。
    要真正理解“空”，不能只在家裡讀書，一定要離開家，認識更大的世界。這就是為什麼葡提老師預見到孫悟空命裡會有大事發生，雖然知道他會遇到很多危險，但還是讓他離開。後來，孫悟空會遇到第二個重要的師父唐三藏，那時他會得到新名字“孫行者”——意思是“修行的人”或“旅行的人”。從那以後，孫悟空就要開始他“西遊”的旅行了。

sentences.simplified: 在中国文化中，人们很早就相信“天人合一”，
sentences.traditional: 在中國文化中，人們很早就相信“天人合一”，
sentences.pinyin: zài zhōng guó wén huà zhōng rén men hěn zǎo jiù xiāng xìn tiān rén hé yī
sentences.english: In Chinese culture, people have long believed in the concept of the “unity of heaven and man”, ..

sentences.simplified: 要通过修炼自身来理解自然。
sentences.traditional: 要通過修煉自身來理解自然。
sentences.pinyin: yào tōng guò xiū liàn zì shēn lái lǐ jiě zì rán
sentences.english: .. seeking to understand nature through self-cultivation.

sentences.simplified: 其中“道”、“心”、“空”都是很重要的内容。
sentences.traditional: 其中“道”、“心”、“空”都是很重要的內容。
sentences.pinyin: qí zhōng dào xīn kōng dōu shì hěn zhòng yào de nèi róng
sentences.english: Among them, the “Way”, the “heart-mind”, and “emptiness” are all very important topics.

sentences.simplified: 中国人认为，修炼的方法有很多种。
sentences.traditional: 中國人認為，修煉的方法有很多種。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó rén rèn wéi xiū liàn de fāng fǎ yǒu hěn duō zhǒng
sentences.english: Chinese people believe that there are many ways to practice self-cultivation.

sentences.simplified: 有些人心思纯净，这样的人更容易修炼。
sentences.traditional: 有些人心思純淨，這樣的人更容易修煉。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu xiē rén xīn si chún jìng zhè yàng de rén gèng róng yì xiū liàn
sentences.english: Some people have a pure state of mind, and such individuals find it easier to practice self-cultivation.

sentences.simplified: 他们往往学习能力特别好。
sentences.traditional: 他們往往學習能力特別好。
sentences.pinyin: tā men wǎng wǎng xué xí néng lì tè bié hǎo
sentences.english: They are often particularly good at learning things.

sentences.simplified: 比如孙悟空出生几天就会跑和跳，
sentences.traditional: 比如孫悟空出生幾天就會跑和跳，
sentences.pinyin: bǐ rú sūn wù kōng chū shēng jǐ tiān jiù huì pǎo hé tiào
sentences.english: For example, Sun Wukong could run and jump just a few days after being born.

sentences.simplified: 很快学会说话，跟葡提老师学习也特别快。
sentences.traditional: 很快學會說話，跟葡提老師學習也特別快。
sentences.pinyin: hěn kuài xué huì shuō huà gēn pú tí lǎo shī xué xí yě tè bié kuài
sentences.english: He learned to speak quickly and also learned particularly fast from Teacher Puti.

sentences.simplified: 对这样的人来说，学东西不是难事，难的是真正理解“空”的意思，
sentences.traditional: 對這樣的人來說，學東西不是難事，難的是真正理解“空”的意思，
sentences.pinyin: duì zhè yàng de rén lái shuō xué dōng xi bú shì nán shì nán de shì zhēn zhèng lǐ jiě kōng de yì si
sentences.english: For these types of people, learning things is not difficult. The challenge is truly understanding the meaning of “emptiness”.

sentences.simplified: 所以葡提老师给他取名“悟空”。
sentences.traditional: 所以葡提老師給他取名“悟空”。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǐ pú tí lǎo shī gěi tā qǔ míng wù kōng
sentences.english: That is why Teacher Puti gave him the name “Wukong”.

sentences.simplified: 要真正理解“空”，不能只在家里读书，一定要离开家，认识更大的世界。
sentences.traditional: 要真正理解“空”，不能只在家裡讀書，一定要離開家，認識更大的世界。
sentences.pinyin: yào zhēn zhèng lǐ jiě kōng bù néng zhǐ zài jiā lǐ dú shū yí dìng yào lí kāi jiā rèn shi gèng dà de shì jiè
sentences.english: To truly understand “emptiness”, one cannot just read books at home—it is necessary to leave home and experience the wider world.

sentences.simplified: 这就是为什么葡提老师预见到孙悟空命里会有大事发生，
sentences.traditional: 這就是為什麼葡提老師預見到孫悟空命裡會有大事發生，
sentences.pinyin: zhè jiù shì wèi shén me pú tí lǎo shī yù jiàn dào sūn wù kōng mìng lǐ huì yǒu dà shì fā shēng
sentences.english: That is why Teacher Puti foresaw that great events were destined to happen in Sun Wukong’s life.

sentences.simplified: 虽然知道他会遇到很多危险，但还是让他离开。
sentences.traditional: 雖然知道他會遇到很多危險，但還是讓他離開。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán zhī dào tā huì yù dào hěn duō wēi xiǎn dàn hái shi ràng tā lí kāi
sentences.english: Although he knew Sun Wukong would encounter many dangers, he still had him leave.

sentences.simplified: 后来，孙悟空会遇到第二个重要的师父唐三藏，
sentences.traditional: 後來，孫悟空會遇到第二個重要的師父唐三藏，
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái sūn wù kōng huì yù dào dì èr ge zhòng yào de shī fu táng sān zàng
sentences.english: Later, Sun Wukong would meet his second important master, Tang Sanzang.

sentences.simplified: 那时他会得到新名字“孙行者”——意思是“修行的人”或“旅行的人”。
sentences.traditional: 那時他會得到新名字“孫行者”——意思是“修行的人”或“旅行的人”。
sentences.pinyin: nà shí tā huì dé dào xīn míng zi sūn xíng zhě yì si shì xiū xíng de rén huò lǚ xíng de rén
sentences.english: At that time, he would receive a new name, “Sun Xingzhe”—meaning “a cultivator” or “a traveler”.

sentences.simplified: 从那以后，孙悟空就要开始他“西游”的旅行了。
sentences.traditional: 從那以後，孫悟空就要開始他“西遊”的旅行了。
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà yǐ hòu sūn wù kōng jiù yào kāi shǐ tā xī yóu de lǚ xíng le
sentences.english: Starting then, Sun Wukong would embark on his “Journey to the West”.

sentence_translations: In Chinese culture, people have long believed in the concept of the “unity of heaven and man”, ..
.. seeking to understand nature through self-cultivation.
Among them, the “Way”, the “heart-mind”, and “emptiness” are all very important topics.
Chinese people believe that there are many ways to practice self-cultivation.
Some people have a pure state of mind, and such individuals find it easier to practice self-cultivation.
They are often particularly good at learning things.
For example, Sun Wukong could run and jump just a few days after being born.
He learned to speak quickly and also learned particularly fast from Teacher Puti.
For these types of people, learning things is not difficult. The challenge is truly understanding the meaning of “emptiness”.
That is why Teacher Puti gave him the name “Wukong”.
To truly understand “emptiness”, one cannot just read books at home—it is necessary to leave home and experience the wider world.
That is why Teacher Puti foresaw that great events were destined to happen in Sun Wukong’s life.
Although he knew Sun Wukong would encounter many dangers, he still had him leave.
Later, Sun Wukong would meet his second important master, Tang Sanzang.
At that time, he would receive a new name, “Sun Xingzhe”—meaning “a cultivator” or “a traveler”.
Starting then, Sun Wukong would embark on his “Journey to the West”.
